rule: All five channels use VALID/READY handshake; once VALID asserted it must remain until handshake.
Source must not wait for READY before asserting VALID.
Destination permitted to wait for VALID before asserting READY; can also assert READY before VALID.
AWVALID/WVALID/ARVALID must be LOW during reset; RVALID/BVALID must be LOW during reset.
First VALID assertion permitted only after rising ACLK with ARESETn HIGH.
AW channel: all signals (AWADDR/AWLEN/AWSIZE/AWBURST/AWCACHE/AWPROT/AWID/AWLOCK/AWQOS/AWREGION/AWUSER) stable while AWVALID HIGH until handshake.
notes: ZipCPU covers all instantiated signals incl. QOS (L346); omits REGION/USER (no ports).

rule: W channel: WDATA/WSTRB/WLAST/WUSER stable while WVALID HIGH until handshake.
AR channel: all signals (ARADDR/ARLEN/ARSIZE/ARBURST/ARCACHE/ARPROT/ARID/ARLOCK/ARQOS/ARREGION/ARUSER) stable while ARVALID HIGH until handshake.
notes: ZipCPU covers all instantiated signals incl. QOS (L370); omits REGION/USER (no ports).

rule: B channel: BRESP/BID/BUSER stable while BVALID HIGH until handshake.
R channel: RDATA/RRESP/RLAST/RID/RUSER stable while RVALID HIGH until handshake.
No X on VALID/READY signals (all 10: 5×VALID + 5×READY).
No X on AW channel signals when AWVALID HIGH.
No X on W channel signals when WVALID HIGH.
No X on AR channel signals when ARVALID HIGH.
No X on B channel signals when BVALID HIGH.
No X on R channel signals when RVALID HIGH.
Manager must not wait for AWREADY/WREADY before AWVALID/WVALID; subordinate must not wait for BREADY/RREADY before BVALID/RVALID.
notes: Only ARM checks VALID-to-READY dependency direction.

rule: Subordinate must wait for ARVALID+ARREADY before asserting RVALID; subordinate must wait for AW+W(WLAST) before asserting BVALID. Write response must follow last write transfer.
notes: ARM: full state machine (WLAST-before-BRESP + AR-before-RVALID). Yosys: AW->B scoreboard only (under-constrained: no WLAST->B or AR->R dependency). ZipCPU: none.

rule: FIXED burst length 1-16 transfers (both AW and AR).
INCR burst length 1-256 transfers (both AW and AR).
WRAP burst length must be 2/4/8/16 (both AW and AR).
Burst size must not exceed data bus width (both AW and AR).
Burst must not cross 4KB address boundary (both AW and AR).
notes: ARM: internal address counter. Yosys: end_addr=ADDR+(LEN<<SIZE); only checks when ADDR_WIDTH>12.

rule: WRAP burst start address must be aligned to transfer size (both AW and AR).
notes: Yosys checks all non-FIXED bursts (over-constrained: spec only requires WRAP alignment).

rule: AxBURST must not use reserved encoding 2'b11 (both AW and AR).
WSTRB HIGH only for valid data byte lanes.
notes: ARM: WSTRB vs burst address/size. ZipCPU: WSTRB bit validity. Yosys: only full_data_transaction (over-constrained: requires all strobes HIGH).

rule: WLAST must be asserted on final write transfer; RLAST must be asserted on final read transfer.
notes: ARM/ZipCPU: beat count vs AxLEN. Yosys: stability only not correctness.

rule: Write/read data item count must match AxLEN+1.
notes: ARM: per-burst. ZipCPU: pending/outstanding counters. Yosys: none.

rule: Read data ordering: same-ID data must return in address order. Write data must follow address-issue order.
Early burst termination not supported; manager must complete all transfers (can deassert WSTRB to suppress writes).
notes: Informational. No SVA implementation checks this.

rule: AxCACHE must not use reserved encodings (both AW and AR).
notes: Rejects {4 5 8 9 C D} per Table A4-5.

rule: When AxCACHE[1] (Modifiable) is 0 then RA/WA bits must be 0 (both AW and AR).
notes: Yosys AR checker uses ARLOCK in condition instead of !m_bit (over-constrained vs spec).

rule: Exclusive access address aligned to total transaction bytes (both AW and AR).
Max bytes in exclusive burst is 128 (both AW and AR).
Exclusive burst length <= 16 (both AW and AR).
Exclusive bytes must be power of 2 (both AW and AR).
Exclusive write must not start until exclusive read complete; AWID must match prior ARID.
notes: ARM: full sequence enforcement + ID matching. Yosys: only prevents simultaneous (under-constrained: no sequencing).

rule: Exclusive read/write must have same burst size length address and control signals.
notes: Only ARM checks matching burst params between excl read and write.

rule: AXI4: locked transactions removed; AxLOCK is 1-bit.
Exclusive access must not be from cacheable region (both AW and AR).
EXOKAY response only valid for exclusive access (both B and R channels).
Write interleaving depth is 1 in AXI4: W data in same order as AW addresses; no read data interleaving.
notes: Only ARM. Yosys: TODO placeholder for read interleaving.

rule: CSYSREQ/CSYSACK low-power handshake: fall/rise edge dependencies.
Low-power: CSYSREQ/CSYSACK LOW after reset.
CACTIVE must not be X during operation.
During reset data/control signals can be any value; READY signals unconstrained during reset.
DECERR (2'b11) is a valid response in AXI4.
BID must match AWID; RID must match ARID.
notes: ARM: checks both BID and RID. Yosys: BID via scoreboard only. RID: only ARM.

rule: Outstanding write/read transaction tracking and limits.
notes: ZipCPU: counter asserts vs F_LGDEPTH. Yosys: scoreboard overflow.

rule: AXI4-Lite: burst length 1 (AXLEN=0); AXSIZE = bus width; AXBURST = FIXED; WLAST/RLAST = 1.
AXI4-Lite: data bus must be 32 or 64 bits.
AXI4-Lite: exclusive not supported (AXLOCK=0); EXOKAY not valid.
AXI4-Lite: IDs must be 0; USER signals must be 0; AXCACHE/AXQOS/AXREGION must be 0.
